exact_prompt:
Edit the attached original-source fullcanvas texture into a faithful high-resolution game diffuse texture.
This is a source-only opaqueRGB nearest enlargement of the complete native64x64 UV canvas, not a new scene.
Return the whole same square canvas filling the output at exactly the same normalized UV coordinates.
The black empty background and all original margins remain black.
Preserve the exact source material: muted plain grayscale hand-painted folded/torn paper particle fragments, gently shaded and soft, never smoke, stone, cauliflower clouds, a photographed paper object, or sharply sculpted geometry.
The single compact sheet sits in the upper-right of the center, with its high right pale fold and lower-left folded lobe.
Preserve the original short left edge and the existing middle dark diagonal fold.
Use only very restrained finer soft painted paper surface detail inside the existing shapes, with no newly visible fibre weave or grain network.
Preserve all existing fold locations and orientations, original ragged edges, number of pieces, relative widths, pattern scale, softness and source-relative dim/pale intensities.
Preserve every faint original region without brightening it into a new hard white tip or separate puff.
Keep dark gray and pale gray source shading neutral gray; no new color or glow.
Do not add folds, creases, ribs, text, numbers, glyphs, logos, marks, tears, edges, dots, sparkles, curls, rays, outlines, borders, bevels, cast shadows or new islands.
No recentering, zoom, rotation, crop, padding, white backdrop or composition redesign.
Output opaque RGB; the original native alpha mask is restored separately.
Brightness will be corrected numerically later, so retain the same relative contrast and intensity across source shapes.

source_transform_recipe.operations: native stored RGBA to opaqueRGB only; wholecanvas NEAREST8x, preserve original aspect; no crop/padding/rotation/UV fitting/BBox/composite/unpremultiplication/art insertion. Original sourceA restored separately by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to exact original4x, sourceA LANCZOS4x separately; private scalar brightness/native premultiply matches Type.

prompt_serialization: Exact built-in prompt argument preserves CRLF and equals UTF-8 prompt file bytes without trailing newline.
reference_argument_serialization: Actual reference tool arguments used absolute repository paths. Portable metadata names exact reference PNG identities with unchanged byte SHA256.
